picks.name: Milwaukie Porchfest
picks.description: Dozens of local musicians perform on front porches across Milwaukie's neighborhoods. Grab a map, pick a route, and wander at your own pace. It's one of the most charming free music experiences in the Portland area.

picks.name: Mermaid Parade
picks.description: Portland's beloved annual parade takes over the waterfront. Expect mermaids, sea creatures, elaborate costumes, and pure community joy. All ages welcome — come dressed up or just come to cheer.

picks.name: Community Blocks Fair
picks.description: A neighborhood street fair on SE 42nd with local vendors, live music, food carts, and community energy. Free all day and all ages — a quintessential Portland summer Saturday.

picks.name: Portland Thai Festival
picks.description: Two days of authentic Thai food, cultural performances, traditional dance, and community celebration near the Burnside Bridgehead. One of Portland's most vibrant free cultural festivals — bring your appetite.

picks.name: 90s Hip-Hop Strings Concert
picks.description: The Candlelight concert series reimagines 90s hip-hop classics performed by a live string ensemble — inside The Old Church, one of Portland's most beautiful historic venues. Tickets required; grab them before they sell out.

picks.name: 90's & 2000's GLOW Night
picks.description: Break out the glow sticks. An all-out 90s and 2000s dance party inside the Crystal Ballroom. This will be jam-packed with millennials ready to boogie. Dress for the heat!

picks.name: Montavilla Street Fair
picks.description: The annual Montavilla Street Fair shuts down SE Stark for a full day of local makers, food carts, live music, and community. Free all day and all ages — one of summer's best neighborhood fairs in Portland.

picks.name: Rubber Duck Races
picks.description: Watch rubber ducks race down a course at Starday Tavern. Free entry, summer vibes, and a healthy dose of silliness. A perfect low-key Sunday afternoon. Not saying you can't get REALLY into it though.
